# Twenty Immediate Improvements To The Plan

1. Prove the launcher exists in a production-faithful browser before changing product pages.
2. Use canonical catalog metadata instead of duplicating descriptions in generated SEO artifacts.
3. Separate public experiences from canonical monetizable products so commerce claims never leak onto noncanonical entries.
4. Keep static crawlable inventory accessible as HTML while runtime JS progressively enhances it.
5. Avoid hidden duplicate links/cards that confuse screen readers when JS hydration starts.
6. Generate sitemaps from resolved public routes rather than filesystem guessing.
7. Include canonical URLs and social metadata only for routes that actually resolve.
8. Add JSON-LD `SoftwareApplication`/`VideoGame` only when required fields are truthful.
9. Keep private product content, filenames, transcripts, documents, prompts, and source code out of telemetry.
10. Define one event vocabulary before instrumenting multiple products.
11. Measure paid outcome success, not merely checkout clicks.
12. Measure return-after-purchase so lost-context checkout failures become visible.
13. Add readiness failure when live credit packs exist without live handler-backed value.
14. Add readiness failure when a public catalog route has no crawlable title/description/link.
15. Add readiness failure when JS files violate header/tab/<120 laws in touched systems.
16. Time cold-start stages individually instead of guessing which initializer stalls HTTP bind.
17. Do not optimize cold start by skipping required durability/security initialization.
18. Preserve current interactive Apps/Games sorting/search even after static crawlable content exists.
19. Make generated artifacts deterministic so CI can detect drift.
20. Verify generated pages with both source inspection and browser behavior before claiming acquisition readiness.
